_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for Dutchie<->Odoo<->Redis discount field mapping. Committed BYTE-IDENTICALLY in both letsgomint-us and odoo-custom-modules (docs/mappings/discount-canonical.json). Code constants in discountCanonical.js (JS) and discount_canonical.py (Odoo) are validated against this file by drift-guard tests. Do NOT hand-edit code maps; edit this file and let both sides re-derive. odooType values reuse the EXISTING mint.discount selection keys. Live-verified against prod Odoo + prod Redis 2026-06-05.

calcMethods.note: $X off the item. Value lives in discount_value (discount_amount is 0). e.g. '$5 off'. odooType 'fixed' = the existing 'Fixed Amount Off' selection.
X% off. Value is a 0-1 fraction in discount_amount (0.35 = 35%). e.g. '35% Off'.
Set unit price to $X. e.g. 'BOGO $.01', single-item price override.
$X off the ORDER total (threshold_type=order_total). Value in discount_value. e.g. '$20 off $50'.
Bundle: 'N for $X'. discount_amount is the bundle TOTAL (43 for '2 For $43'); threshold_min is N.
Loyalty point multiplier (NOT a price discount). Multiplier in discount_value. e.g. '4.2X Loyalty'. odooType 'points_multiplier' = existing 'Loyalty Points Multiplier' selection.

thresholdTypes.note: Live-confirmed 2026-06-05: 10 prod rows, all calc-5 ($X off $Y) order-level deals.
Conventional Dutchie ordering; 0 live rows as of 2026-06-05. Consumers MUST warn-on-unmapped rather than assume.
